method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: Stabilise with lower yields – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank's Jim Reid notes that US equities stabilised after three consecutive declines, with the S&P 500 gaining 0.46% as strength in the Magnificent Seven, particularly Nvidia and Meta, supported the market.
Equities.reason: Market-level piece tying lower yields to a stabilising S&P and leadership from the Magnificent Seven (AI/large-cap tech). Broad macro and liquidity/yield narrative supports risk-on — high relevance.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Rises to Snap Three-Day Skid as Oil Prices Halt Advance
Equities.reason: Broad-market move: S&P steadies. Oil pausing removes an upside inflation/energy shock, modestly supportive for equities — market-regime signal but not a major shock.

Equities.title: Google starts September with AI momentum after longest monthly losing streak in over a decade
Equities.summary: After a slow but extended selloff on Wall Steet, Google began September with renewed momentum, helped by new AI models.
Equities.reason: Significant tech/AI bellwether showing renewed momentum; reinforces AI leadership narrative that is driving large-cap equity performance and risk appetite.

Equities.title: Snowflake spikes 22% on healthy results and AI coding momentum
Equities.summary: Snowflake business is growing quickly, in part thanks to adoption of an artificial intelligence agent for writing code.
Equities.reason: Company-level beat tied explicitly to AI adoption; while single-stock, the move amplifies the AI-driven rally theme across software/cloud names — moderate relevance as corroborating evidence.

Equities.title: Microsoft to start disclosing Azure quarterly revenue as company consolidates business units
Equities.summary: Microsoft will begin reporting quarterly Azure revenue in dollars for the first time, providing more clarity about its business that competes with AWS.
Equities.reason: Improves earnings transparency for a major cloud/AI provider. Incrementally supportive for tech sector sentiment and helps reduce uncertainty around cloud growth.

Equities.title: AI trade faces test with next week's Oracle earnings
Equities.summary: How Michael Khouw is playing ORCL ahead of earnings.
Equities.reason: A near-term earnings event that could challenge the AI trade narrative if results disappoint. Included as a lower-relevance near-term risk to the broader AI-driven market rally.

Equities.title: Asian stock markets reflect mixed trend in countdown to US NFP data
Equities.summary: Stock markets in the Asian region demonstrate a mixed performance as investors shift their focus to the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for August, which will be released on Friday.
Equities.reason: Mixed regional flows ahead of key US jobs data — reflects macro uncertainty/two-way risk around yields and liquidity; small negative given uncertainty rather than directional shock.

Equities.title: Iran strikes Kuwait as Trump says renewed Mideast hostilities will not last 'too long'
Equities.summary: On Thursday, Kuwait's army said it was confronting hostile missile and drone attacks from Iran.
Equities.reason: Geopolitical escalation in the Middle East raises risk-off pressure, can lift energy risk premia and dent broader equity sentiment — meaningful negative for market risk tone.

Equities.title: South Korea's semiconductor exports just tripled year-over-year. Is it too much of a good thing?
Equities.summary: If growth were to slow in the semiconductor sector, would the slowdown take the Korean economy with it?
Equities.reason: Strong semiconductor export data supports the cyclical/tech upside narrative (benefitting chip names and broader tech leadership). Slight caveat around sustainability — moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Global Bond Yields Surge as Oil Prices Fuel Inflation Worries
Rates.reason: Headline signals broad, oil-driven inflation scare that is lifting yields and driving a global bond selloff — core rates narrative is higher-for-longer, high relevance to Rates.

Rates.title: 10-year U.S. Treasury yield hits highest level since November 2023
Rates.summary: The 10-year Treasury note yield reached a fresh multiyear high on Wednesday as inflation and debt concerns pressured global government borrowing costs.
Rates.reason: Direct market data: multiyear high in the 10y is a clear signal of bond selloff and upward pressure on policy expectations — high direct relevance for Rates.

Rates.title: The world appears to be entering a higher-rate era. Here’s who will pay the price
Rates.summary: The bond sell-off is owed to a mix of high government debt issuance, an oil-price shock that has reignited inflation concerns, and expectations of higher rates.
Rates.reason: Macro thematic piece pointing to a structural shift to higher yields (issuance, oil/inflation, policy expectations) — important regime signal for Rates.

Rates.title: Fed's Barr: If inflation doesn't moderate, the central bank should raise rates
Rates.reason: Fed official signalling readiness to hike if inflation remains sticky increases rate path risk — direct policy transmission to Treasury yields, moderately high relevance.

Rates.title: New York Fed's Williams says yield surge due to strong economic prospects
Rates.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said higher Treasury yields reflect a strong economy as he weighs whether another interest rate hike is needed.
Rates.reason: Official attribution of yield rise to strong growth reinforces expectations for restrictive/longer policy — negative for bond prices, moderate relevance.

Rates.title: BoJ mulls hiking interest rates to 1.25% in September meeting – Bloomberg
Rates.summary: According to a report from Bloomberg, the Bank of Japan (BoJ) is leaning toward raising its benchmark interest rate by a quarter point in the two-day meeting ending on September 18 in response to upward price risks.
Rates.reason: Potential BoJ tightening is a meaningful cross-market driver that can lift global rates and raise the JGB risk premium — materially negative for global bond prices.

Rates.title: Japan’s 30-Year Bond Auction Risks Adding Fuel to Debt Selloff
Rates.reason: Auction dynamics and supply risk in a large JGB sale can exacerbate the broader selloff — direct market mechanics risk for Rates.

Rates.title: Philippines Reconsiders Five-Year Jumbo Bond Sale on High Inflation, Weak Peso
Rates.reason: Emerging-market issuance being pulled/reconsidered due to inflation and FX stress signals strained funding conditions and higher EM yields — negative, single-country but relevant for creditor-risk spreads.

Rates.title: Pakistan Raises $3 Billion in Two-Part Junk Bond Sale
Rates.reason: Large high-yield sovereign issuance underscores strained EM funding and higher demanded yields; relevant to global credit and Rates but more idiosyncratic.

Rates.title: There Are Four Forces Pressuring Bonds: War Is No. 1
Rates.reason: Analysis highlighting geopolitical risk as a primary structural driver of the bond selloff — reinforces higher-yield/ risk-premium narrative for Rates.

Rates.title: JPMorgan curbed lending to Jane Street as trading firm muscled into bonds
Rates.summary: Wall Street bank’s move last year came after trading specialist began making markets in US Treasuries
Rates.reason: Market-structure / liquidity story: reduced bank intermediation can amplify volatility and exacerbate selloffs — relevant but more structural/medium-term.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: Bonds breathe sigh of relief
Rates.reason: Short-term reprieve/easing in yields mentioned by market note — small counter-signal to the dominant selloff, limited relevance.

Rates.title: United States Dollar Index weakens below 99.50 as yields ease
Rates.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 99.40 in the early European trading hours on Thursday. The DXY faces some selling pressure while US Treasury yields
Rates.reason: Notes a link between easing US yields and a softer USD; a modest, short-lived signal that yields can retrace — small positive for bond prices.

Rates.title: Shares, bonds rally as markets await signals for Fed rates
Rates.reason: Market positioning ahead of Fed signals can produce temporary bond rallies; included as a lower-relevance, near-term countervailing flow.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar rises on weaker US Dollar, rising oil prices
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its losses for the second consecutive day, trading around 1.3830 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The currency pair experiences downward pressure as a sharp rally in the Japanese Yen (JPY) weighed heavily on the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: FX-native note showing CAD strength driven by a weaker USD (and oil tailwind). Supports the broader intraday USD-softness narrative tied to a strong JPY and cross-market flows into commodity-linked currencies (CAD).

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Bears target 156.50 support zone amid sharp Yen appreciation
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair remains under intense selling pressure for the second straight day and plummets to a nearly four-week low, around the 157.25-157.20 region during the early European session on Thursday.
FX.reason: Direct FX-market move: sharp JPY appreciation is the dominant intraday driver. High relevance because USD/JPY moves are central to global FX flows and potential BoJ intervention risk that is spilling into other pairs.

FX.title: Yen Traders Brace for Holiday Intervention Risk Around BOJ
FX.reason: Intervention risk is a major structural FX theme — increases the probability of abrupt JPY moves and cross-border FX flow reactions. This item reinforces the market regime: JPY strength and USD vulnerability are driving broader FX positioning.

FX.title: Yen strengthens as traders bet on Japan interest rate rises
FX.summary: Currency rises close to ¥156 to the dollar after sudden jump overnight
FX.reason: Authoritative confirmation of the JPY rally and rate-expectation driver. Reinforces the dominant market narrative of stronger JPY and associated USD weakness; material for FX positioning and volatility.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah strengthens as US Dollar declines on potential Yen intervention
FX.summary: USD/IDR loses ground for the second successive day, trading around 17,730 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The currency pair experiences downward pressure as a sharp rally in the Japanese Yen (JPY) weighed heavily on the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: EMFX reaction to broader USD softness driven by JPY moves and intervention chatter. Relevant as it shows cross-border FX flow impact beyond G10, reinforcing the USD-weakness / JPY-strength narrative.

FX.title: British Pound drops to three-week low as hawkish BoJ and suspected intervention boost Yen
FX.summary: The GBP/JPY cross remains under intense selling pressure for the second straight day and drops to a three-and-a-half-week low, around the 212.75-212.70 region during the Asian session on Thursday.
FX.reason: Cross-market highlight of how BoJ/JPY developments are reshaping G10 cross rates. Included because suspected intervention/hawkish BoJ is a major regime theme; here it pressures GBP via GBP/JPY and signals wider JPY dominance.

FX.title: Euro: Downside risk persists toward 1.1550 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that EUR/USD has shifted into short-term range trading between 1.1570 and 1.1610 after a dip to 1.1565 and rebound to 1.1608. They still see scope for a test of 1.1550 unless 1.1630 strong r
FX.reason: Bank research highlighting downside risk for EUR vs USD — a counter-signal to the USD-weakness theme. Lower relevance because it is a single-bank technical view amid stronger market-wide JPY-driven flows.

FX.title: Swiss Franc bounces up from monthly lows as GDP, inflation data beat expectations
FX.summary: The Swiss Franc (CHF) accelerated its recovery against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday’s early European session, as Swiss inflation and economic growth data beat expectations.
FX.reason: Local-data-driven CHF strength vs USD. Relevant at the pair level but lower in the cross-market hierarchy — it supports pockets of non-JPY currency strength amid the broader USD dynamic.

FX.title: US Dollar: Upside risks persist – ING
FX.summary: ING strategists Francesco Pesole, Frantisek Taborsky and Chris Turner note that a sharp USD/JPY move briefly weighed on the Dollar, but only Australian Dollar and Canadian Dollar held gains.
FX.reason: Major bank view signaling potential USD resilience / upside risks — included as a lower-relevance counterpoint to headlines of USD weakness. Useful for assessing whether JPY-led moves are durable or transient.

Commodities.title: Gold stands firm as USD dives to one-week low; Fed hike bets cap gains
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) built on its recovery from a nearly four-week low for the second straight day on Thursday, though it remains below $4,450 through the first half of the European session. The US Dollar (USD) plummets to a one-week low and is seen as a key factor
Commodities.reason: USD weakness and falling bond yields are supportive for gold (safe-haven/real-rate trade). Fed hike risk caps upside but the near-term directional impulse is positive for the yellow metal.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD extends gains as US Dollar falls further, NFP comes into focus
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its Wednesday recovery move on Thursday, trading 0.67% higher at around $65.70 during the European trading session. The white metal strengthens as the US Dollar (USD) declines further due to moderate job demand in the United Stat
Commodities.reason: Dollar-driven rally for silver; this is a price-forecast/technical piece so relevance is capped. Net effect: short-term positive for silver.

Commodities.title: Energy Secretary Chris Wright works to finalize oil deal in Venezuela
Commodities.reason: A finalized oil deal with Venezuela implies a potential increase in market supply from sanctioned barrels, which is bearish for oil prices if implemented.

Commodities.title: Dutch central bank moves gold bars out of U.S. and Canada, citing ‘crisis preparedness’
Commodities.summary: DNB said gold stored with the Bank of England is more readily tradable, allowing it to be deployed more quickly in a severe crisis.
Commodities.reason: Central-bank repositioning of gold signals policy-level focus on reserves and crisis-readiness but has only modest direct impact on market prices or liquidity.

Commodities.title: Energy Secretary Chris Wright tells CNBC more than 17 million barrels of oil transited Hormuz on Monday
Commodities.summary: The Energy secretary spoke to CNBC's Brian Sullivan in Venezuela on Wednesday, after President Donald Trump announced a massive oil deal with Caracas.
Commodities.reason: Record transit volumes through the Strait of Hormuz reduce the near-term supply-disruption risk premium for oil, which is modestly bearish for prices.

Commodities.title: U.S. LNG exports rose 23% in the first half of 2026 because of higher capacity
Commodities.summary: U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports averaged 17.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in the first six months of the year, 23% more than the same period in 2025, according to our Natural Gas Monthly. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we estimate U.S
Commodities.reason: Material increase in U.S. LNG exports reflects higher global gas flows and tighter physical gas balances in destination markets — supportive for gas prices and energy commodity tightness.

Commodities.title: Oil: Rally pace moderates after Iran strikes – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank analysts note that Brent extended its rally and closed above USD95, although gains moderated after President Trump suggested the renewed US bombing campaign against Iran could be short-lived.
Commodities.reason: Iran strikes and geopolitical risk have driven an oil rally; commentary that strikes may be brief tempers gains but overall the geopolitical impulse remains supportive for oil.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Consolidates above $89.00; bullish bias remains amid Iran risks
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on a modest Asian session uptick and currently trades just above the $89.00 mark, unchanged for the day.
Commodities.reason: Price-forecast/market-commentary highlights continued bullish bias driven by Iran-related risk premium; meaningful for oil near-term direction.

Commodities.title: China’s Waning Appetite for Oil Is Keeping Emissions in Check
Commodities.reason: A structural slowdown in China's oil demand is a significant macro headwind for global oil markets and weighs on the price outlook — a material negative for oil.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Three-Day Gain as Trump Says Iran Strikes to be Brief
Commodities.reason: Oil continuing to hold gains reflects ongoing geopolitical premium; Trump's comment that strikes may be brief tempers but does not eliminate the supportive risk premium.

Commodities.title: USTR's Greer huddles with House Republicans amid Trump trade spats
Commodities.summary: Trump's plan to lower tariffs on 300,000 metric tons of imported beef caused an uproar among cattle ranchers.
Commodities.reason: Policy to lower tariffs on beef imports would increase competition/imports and is modestly bearish for US cattle/beef prices (live cattle commodity impact).

Commodities.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
Commodities.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
Commodities.reason: New pipeline capacity improves distribution and eases regional bottlenecks for petroleum liquids, a modest bearish structural factor for oil/product price volatility.

Commodities.title: Dangote refinery drives increase in petroleum shipments from Nigeria
Commodities.summary: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, playing an increasing role in the international market for petroleum products at a time when supplies from other areas have been constrained.
Commodities.reason: Increased refined-product exports from Nigeria via the Dangote refinery add incremental global supply and relieve some product tightness — modestly bearish for oil/product prices.

Crypto.title: CrowdStrike and federal authorities dismantle Russian malware that secretly stole crypto for 8 years
Crypto.reason: Law-enforcement takedown improves security and trust in crypto plumbing; reduces illicit-exit risks and is a net positive for institutional confidence.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin slips below $76,500 as U.S. strikes on Iran send oil above $93
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical shock triggered broad risk-off and crypto selloff; meaningful near-term negative impact on market liquidity/risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin back above $77,500, XRP leads majors as Fed hike odds slide to 62%
Crypto.reason: Easing Fed-hike odds lifts risk assets and crypto; monetary backdrop moving less restrictive is a strong positive for prices and flows.

Crypto.title: Capital B aims to add 376 BTC to bitcoin treasury following $8.8 million Adam Back investment
Crypto.reason: Corporate treasury accumulation increases structural demand for BTC; positive for long-term supply/demand dynamics.

Crypto.title: SEC proposes transfer agent rule, sets event to figure out round-the-clock U.S. trading
Crypto.reason: Market-structure/regulatory proposal could bring clarity on trading/operational rules; modestly positive by reducing uncertainty around 24/7 trading and custody practices.

Crypto.title: Dogecoin becomes only losing bet for Japan-listed firm as it sells altcoins for bitcoin
Crypto.reason: Flows rotating from alts into bitcoin indicate consolidation into BTC; small positive for BTC dominance, limited market-wide impact.

Crypto.title: DOJ says Hamas crypto seizures reached $560,000 as FBI took over fundraising sites
Crypto.reason: Enforcement action against illicit crypto fundraising supports the narrative of stronger compliance and law-enforcement capability; small absolute impact given seizure size.

Crypto.title: Crypto made new friends in U.S. primaries, but focus now shifts to general election
Crypto.reason: Political gains increase the chance of crypto-friendly policy framing ahead of the general election; positive medium-term regulatory outlook.

Crypto.title: The token supercycle: everything of value is becoming programmable
Crypto.reason: Opinion piece outlining a structural bullish thesis for tokenisation; supportive for long-term narrative but lower relevance for near-term market moves.

Crypto.title: The bearish 'Bart Simpson' pattern is back as bitcoin and XRP prices pull back
Crypto.reason: Technical-pattern discussion flags downside risk and short-term momentum loss; price-technical stories have capped relevance.

Crypto.title: A China indicator that supports risk-taking in stocks and bitcoin is flashing red
Crypto.reason: China macro/market signals turning negative reduce global risk appetite and weigh on crypto demand; meaningful cross-market transmission.

Crypto.title: OpenAI says its new 'Astra' AI can build attacks without human help
Crypto.reason: Advances in automated attack capability raise cyber-risk to crypto infrastructure and smart contracts; modest negative for operational risk profile.

Crypto.title: Solana, ether, xrp lead majors slide as Iran strikes drive a broad risk selloff
Crypto.reason: Geopolitically driven risk-off impacted altcoins strongly; reinforces market-wide negative move and liquidity stress in majors.

Crypto.title: Robinhood's new crypto network is printing cash, and it's sending Arbitrum's token soaring
Crypto.reason: Product adoption and revenue generation from a major retail platform boosts token-level demand and signals healthy network monetization; positive for ecosystem flows.
